item.title: BIS Student Chapter
item.description: The BIS Student Chapter at IIT Kanpur connects academia with industrial standards to foster quality and innovation. It empowers students to become industry-ready professionals who advance India’s standardization ecosystem.

item.title: Speed Cubing
item.description: a vibrant community of puzzle enthusiasts dedicated to the art and science of solving twisty puzzles like the Rubik’s Cube. We are one of the dynamic clubs under the Science and Technology (SnT) Council of the Students’ Gymkhana, fostering curiosity, logic, and hands-on learning.
